dedupe_keys.name: bauliche hochwasserschutzanlagen in stadt und umland

description: Bauliche Hochwasserschutzanlagen in Stadt und Umland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). This dataset shows the structural flood protection systems in Hamburg and its surroundings. The data presented are based on the contents of the flood hazard and flood risk maps for the second reporting cycle (2019-2025). In Hamburg, a distinction is made between coastal flooding and inland flooding. Coverage: Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). The portal shows the English title as "Structural flood protection systems in the city and surrounding area" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). Its keywords include hmbtg, Geodaten, REGI, ENVI. The listing shows 2024-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
